issue.pageTitle: GatorBait Magazine | Game Day: Florida at Texas

cover.headline: Who's QB1 in Austin?
cover.dek: Philo is hurt. Jones hasn't started a game since Mandarin High. Buddy Martin calls in Ted Lasso to explain the quarterback question, and why calm is not surrender.

image.alt: GatorBait Magazine Friday Pregame cover, Oct. 16, 2026, in the broadcast set style: chrome masthead, orange slab reading Florida at No. 7 Texas, Chris Spears' photo of Tramell Jones Jr. in the shotgun on the set's screen, and the headline Who's QB1 in Austin?
image.credit: Photo by Chris Spears, GatorBait Media
